text: I had laser eye surgery here about three years ago and I really could not be happier with the results. I don't remember the exact cost, but I believe it was about $2500. I chose the most expensive package option so I am covered for eye exams and any touch up surgeries needed in the future if my eye sight changes again. There are some cheaper options available also. The clinic was very comfortable and well organized, and all the staff I saw were very friendly and professional. The actual eye surgery was completely painless and only took a few minutes. In all honesty, going to the dentist is more uncomfortable than the surgery was here. My recovery time was very quick too, I only took one day off work and my vision was perfect by the next day. Very good experience, highly recommended if you want to live without glasses and contacts.

WOW! As someone who has been dependant on glasses her entire life, never worn contacts either, the thought of laser eye surgery has always seemed quite daunting. I had a pre op visit with Lasik MD back in August 2014 and had a wonderful experience with the staff and even booked a surgery appointment for December. However, my nerves got the best of me and I cancelled my surgery. I took a deep breath, booked another appointment and yesterday (March 27,2015!) I finally did it! I had the most amazing experience with every single person at Lasik MD in Edmonton. From the receptionist to each person who scanned my eyes and did different tests to the surgeon and all of the comforting staff in the operating room, they were all encouraging and so excited for me and my big day! Even the other patients in the clinic were all happy and excited, it was such a fun, positive experience for me that i had initially been very hesitant to do. It has only been a day but I was so impressed with the friendly, professional and compassionate staff that I had to give them a shout out! I have had no issues with my eyes, just the slight blurriness on the first day that was to be expected (it has already become clearer since yesterday, though!) I will update my journey as my vision continues to improve. For anyone considering laser eye treatment, Lasik MD in Edmonton is where you want to go; exceptional staff, the most advanced treatments,  a clean, welcoming lounge with more than enough cookies, apples, tea and coffee to keep everyone happy and, most importantly, amazing results! Thank you everyone at Lasik MD!!

I just had enhancement surgery on my right eye.  My original surgery was 11 years ago.  I started wearing glasses again about 1.5 years ago so decided it was time to try again as I have the lifetime plan.  I still have not decided if the enhancement was a good idea or not as my eyes are still adjusting (they only do one eye at a time the second time!).
My main concern this time around has been the constant lack of communication between the office staff regarding my surgery confirmation.  After my final pre-op consult, I was told I would receive a call within a week to confirm the surgeon's approval...no call came.  I had at call myself twice, both times was told they would call back before a certain time (which did not happen).. Finally after I caalled a third call , i received confirmation. 
 Again the day before surgery, they left a message to confirm the time on my voicemail and said they would e-mail the instructions for surgery day...no e-mail was ever sent.  Luckily I phoned to check before they closed for the day. 
 I'm not sure if their lack of communication was due to the fact that they already had my money...? I did bring up my concerns following surgery and was told that someone would call me to discuss my concerns.  Not surprisingly...no body has called.
On the plus side, Dr. Riyaz was excellent.  He had remarkable bedside manner and was patient about answering my questions.

Tired of your glasses? Then you're looking at the right place.

Lasik MD provided both myself and my ex-girlfriend with vision correction about 2 years ago. Both of us couldn't be happier with how it turned out. The surgery itself was very short and painless. Within a day our vision had nearly fully returned to a state way better than it previously was. All of the staff were very kind and answered any questions we had at any point in time.

Everyone always asks how much it costs, but that is entirely dependent on which type of surgery you need. I will say that it was quite expensive but I truly believe it was one of the best things I have ever done for myself. I recommend LASIK to anyone, even if it's not this specific clinic.

I believe they still give free consultations, checking your vision and then giving you a cost analysis for the specific type of surgery you need. There's literally nothing to lose.

Why not 5 stars then you're wondering? Well they're so busy that sometimes it's hard to get in! They are very forgiving about switching appointment times and that kind of stuff, so it's not that big of a deal.

Is your decision about vision correction a little blurry? Well walk into LASIK and when you walk out, it'll be crystal clear!

I'm 10 days post op from getting wave front laser eye enhancement. I had nearsighted vision due to a stigmatism and severe dry eye. I had a consult 4 years ago and was happy the price hadn't changed since then. I paid $3280 for both eyes and lifetime warranty($150/eye). I also got permanent plugs for my dry eye extra ($100/eye). The post op drops are $50 extra. I liked the non pushy sales here. I never felt guilty 4 years ago for not getting the surgery right away while still getting very polite customer service. They finance through Desjardins where I got the 0 down and 0 interest till 2017. 

The first day you see about 5 different people. Which I can see how some people would think that means you don't get continuent care but they all have access to your file and everyone I saw knew everything as its recorded. I got all my questions answered and everyone was very kind. First you get an eye exam, then do financing/payment, talk to a councillor about post op, get your final measurements, surgery prep and then you see the surgeon.

The surgery itself: They look at your eyes and apply lots of numbing drops. First they tape back your eye lashes and put in an instrument that looks like an eyelash curler to hold your lids open. It's uncomfortable but fine. Next the take a round plastic instrument and apply pressure exposing the eye and making the cut for the flap. everything goes black so you don't see anything during this. I'll admit this part I found very painful. They push this down for about 10 sec and it pushed very hard on the ocular bones of the skull. It caught me off guard for the first eye but was very difficult for the second. Next they take the pressure off and remove the flap which looked like taking a contact lens off and everything went blurry. They scrape the top layer and then you see the red and green lasers over head but don't feel anything. Then they put the flap back and apply more drops and you hold your eyes closed for a few seconds. That's all.

After they put you in a dark corner with your sunglasses on to rest. A counsellor comes to check on you and apply the post op drops. You stay here for about 45 mins. After this they do an exam on you to make sure everything is fine. Your eyes are very uncomfortable and the eye drops burn very badly for the first few days, almost like putting alcohol on a wound. It's not pleasant.

When at home I wasn't allowed to do literally anything. No reading, tv, drawing, nothing. I laid in bed and listened to my ipod all day long. So incredibly bored. And the eye drop schedule is ridiculous , I had to get help to keep track of them. And they leave a terrible taste in the back of your throat and nose.  The sunglasses are a big pain to sleep with also so just don't expect to sleep well for the first few nights. My left eye was particularly sore and felt like I had a big rock stuck in it. The clinic called to check on me which was nice but the councillor I was not happy with. I told her about my left eye and she told me, "this is normal for one to hurt more than the other. It's usually all in your head." I was not impressed by being brushed off so. But since I had my follow-up the next morning didn't argue.

Sure enough the next morning I go in and my left lens had gotten wrinkled and needed to be reset. I had to wait around for 2 hrs before the surgeon got there which wasn't fun as I had come prepared to only be there for 30 mins tops. They reset it no problem but now my left eye was a day behind my right and my drop schedule got very confusing. Since then every day has been an improvement. Some times my vision is a little blurry but my eyes are actually feeling less dry then before with the plugs. I am getting bad Ocular headaches when I do lots of computer, driving or high stress at work but not everyday. Still some sensitivity to sunlight only and halos when night driving. I had my one week follow up appointment that showed I had 20/20 vision in both eyes.

So far dealing with the clinic and the treatment itself I have very mixed feelings on. It's still very early on in my vision correction that I'm not singing praises. 

Pros: The optometrist staff and financing staff were wonderful. The optometrists especially were very open and honest. It's very affordable and the clinic itself runs smoothly. The surgery itself went smoothly and everything seems to be working as it should. 
Cons: They focus so much on keeping you calm and trying not to scare you that they downplay a lot of the negatives and pain that you will experience. No one told me about the pain during the surgery that after talking to others we all had which made me furious. Along with the drops burning and stinging. The post op councillor I had I wasn't fond of as she brushed off my concerns with the follow up call and was a little hard to understand. The front desk staff were not overly friendly and seemed more involved with their own gossip at times.

Will update as more time progresses

Totally recommended! I was really hesitant about getting laser eye surgery for my extreme near-sightedness (-5.75 and -7.25) but it was getting to the point where I just couldn't wear contact lenses anymore, nor did I want to wear glasses. I did a lot of research and LASIK MD was having a promotion on financing so I went for a free consultation.

The location in City Centre is really nice - clean and modern, lovely little waiting area with lots of couches and televisions usually playing a nature documentary (so easy on the eyes!). They do a very thorough examination of your eyes with different pieces of equipment. In the end, I was deemed a suitable candidate for a particular type of surgery (oh yes, there are different kinds, and they will go over that with you), so I went ahead with the procedure.

All staff members are friendly, soothing, professional, and competent. My surgery went off without a hitch - I wasn't nervous about it and even asked for them to give me a play-by-play of what they were doing, which they kindly obliged and honestly, I think would comfort most people who are nervous. I did have a tiny bit of halo effect and dry eyes, which is normal, and both went away within a month after the surgery. Four years later my vision is still 20/20, and it's the most amazing thing to wake up and be able to see clearly. The initial cost was a lot of me but since they had the zero-interest promotion, I just paid off the loan with that year's tax refund. 

I highly recommend this place to anyone who is looking to get rid of near or far sightedness! (They advised me I would likely still need reading glasses as I age because this procedure doesn't fix that - but that's totally fine with me!)

LASIK MD has given me the most amazing gift of sight and I could not be happier with the results! The staff were very confident and knowledgeable and made me feel at ease throughout the entire process. From the consultation to the follow up appointments every question and concern were answered. Staff all seemed very happy and enjoyed helping people achieve great vision. Even though the lounge was very busy I always felt like the staff truly cared and wanted to assist each and every patient in any way they could. Amazing experience through and through! I would recommend this company to anyone tired of glasses and contact lenses! Thank you again!
Untrained staff who are unable to answer basic questions or provide solutions. Super disappointing since I had heard good things before experiencing their non-existence customer service first hand.

Just finishing up my third and last visit to Lasik MD. Last April I had my initial surgery done.
Three weeks ago I came in for an enhancement, which I need for both eyes, but,they can only do one at a time. They did my left eye then and right will be done right away.
Every time a patient comes in, you aee multiple people a day. 

I have never once had a bad experience with anyone here. They really go above and beyond with their customer service. 

I would highy recommened LasikMD to anyone looking to get the procedure done.
Loved my outcome. Staff are very knowledgeable and professional. Still 20/20 a year later. I would do it again in a second. I love my life without glasses!

After 21 years of glasses and contacts, I have 20-20 vision! I'd strongly recommend Lasik to anyone who's had to face the complications of contacts, dry eyes, bringing your glasses as back-up, and all of the other annoying things those with less-than-perfect vision have to deal with. The worst part about the whole surgery day is having to wait 4-5 hours for the 3 minute surgery. But it's entirely worth it, because your vision will begin to clear the next day.

The staff and surgery team were all lovely, everyone was very helpful and friendly, and you can tell that they all enjoy their jobs. I'm very happy with the procedure and the brilliant staff at Lasik made everything that much better!

My script was around a -4.00 with a -1.00 astigmatism. I was drawn to Lasik MD because of glowing reviews from my Sister a year ago and their very flexible surgery schedule. They have surgeries every week! I can honestly say, it was one of the best decisions of my life. I decided to go with the Advance Custom procedure with Dr. Dorey, he was very kind was amazingly skilled. Him and his staff ensured I understood how the procedure worked and answered all my questions regarding how to keep my warranty valid. (You just have to visit them for a check up, once every 2 years after surgery!) I never felt rushed, even though the clinic is very busy. They really took their time to ensure I felt comfortable with what I was doing and answered any questions I had thoroughly.  I really appreciate all the time they took to make me feel at ease. A million thanks to the compassionate staff at Lasik MD for giving me 20/20 vision and feeding me all those cookies. This is the place to go, if you are looking to free yourself from glasses, as I did!

I can't even find the right words to express how happy I am that I got this surgery!!! I am just sorry I didn't get it sooner.  Having 20-20 vision after 20 years of glasses and contacts.  I don't even want to think about how much money and stress I spent on those things.  This procedure had almost immediate results.  The next morning I was 20-20. I haven't even had the dry, sand feeling that I heard about! 

The day of surgery my eyes were on the dry side (I blame allergies) so I had to sit around for quite awhile and apply drops and drink a ton of water to hydrate my eyes.  But after that it went very quickly.  I will agree with many people on one thing, the feeling when you are getting the procedure done isn't how I understood when it was being explained.  There was more pressure than I expected, but it wasn't unbearable... the hardest part for me, was to 'look straight at the blinking light' when the lens of your eye has been cut, everything is blurry.  I found this very difficult. But it was over before I knew it and I sat in the dark corner, got my drops and waited for my husband.  I slept from when I got home (around 4) to the next morning at 6am.  I missed so many drops, but I know that keeping your eyes closed is good too. I went to my follow up appointment and I was 20-20 with a little dryness in one eye. (I didn't even notice)

The staff was amazing!!  Very knowledgeable and caring, and very, very thorough! Did I mention the free cookies? :)

I've  had my one year check up this morning. They had advised me at my last appointment to book a few months in advance. I had called in early December and they were already booked till the end of February. But they had a clinic in Oliver square for post op and consultations which was able to take me earlier. I much preferred this to having to go downtown and pay for parking.

They did a quick check of my prescription and then went in for an exam. Happily they said I have better than 20/20 and everything looks healthy. To cover my warranty I have to go back every 2 years and have them check their work. They also recommend to keep going to an optometrist in between to check my overall eye health of course. 

So my initial review I still stand by when it comes to the surgery itself. I highly recommend getting the tear duct plugs. They have helped so much with the dry eye. Also the lifetime warranty I'd recommend. The time goes by so fast. I still have some light sensitivity. Night driving is fine but still get some glares, more noticeable on the highway when it's busy and not so much in town. The dry eye is tough in the winter. I use drops first thing in the morning, at night before bed and a few times in the day. I stopped getting the ocular headaches after a couple weeks post surgery. But the pros I've enjoyed so much! From no fogged up glasses in the cold to wearing sunglasses whenever I want.

This has been the absolute worst decision of my life! Money aside, my vision and eye health have been tremendously affected. Going in, I only had problems with my right eye as I felt my left was fine. They had me convinced that I needed both done. Well, my right eye is slightly better after the surgery while my left is constantly blurry and dry. Their recommendation for this, use eye drops 3+ times a day. I had surgery over 14 months ago. Anyone considering getting this treatment should look elsewhere.

I am 6 months post LASIK surgery and don't have one single regret except that I didn't do it sooner!!

It was last April, I was traveling in Turkey and had my contacts in and they were bugging me so I had to pull out my eye drops and make sure I had my glasses in my bag as a back up. Right then I vowed that when I got home I would look into LASIK. 
I booked an online appointment for a free consult in July. I went on one of my days off from work and got to choose the time! It was a very thorough consult with the eye exams, tests, meeting with the opthomologist and even going over financial aid. I decided to wait until summer was over as I already had a lot going on in my life and needed to make arrangements. 
Well Sept 10th came and after 17 years of wearing glasses/contacts it was all finally going to be over! My vision was a -6.5 in both eyes.. So terrible!
I went in for 8am, brought snacks & waited very comfortably on the couches. I went through more eye exams to make sure nothing changed and then just waited! Just after 10:30 it was my turn! I met with the surgeon and he explained everything. I got my eye drops and I headed in the surgical suite. 11 minutes later I was out and in recovery!!
There was no pain, only minor pressure discomfort for less than a minute. 
I waited an hour in recovery and had my first set of drops placed for me then got my instructions for the rest of the day and next day and booked my recheck for the next day!

LASIK MD has incredible staff who are all so kind and caring and very knowledgeable. The overall experience I had was amazing. I very highly recommend this business and procedure to everyone I know!! I'm so pleased with the results and now have 20/20 vision for the first time since the 6th grade!'

Absolutely the best investment I've ever made and am so happy I did it. The freedom is just so life changing and I can't be more thankful for such an easy experience!!

Thank you LASIK MD for making my life 20/20 better than it was before 

Caresse

I was asked (in person) and called (afterward) several times to update my review, so here is it:

If you're thinking about using LASIK MD - I would ask to speak directly with the downtown location. DO NOT waste your time speaking to the individuals working in the 'call centers' (they are ones who call with vision questions and verify your appointment). 

As soon as I posted my original review: 

"Untrained staff who are unable to answer basic questions or provide solutions. Super disappointing since I had heard good things before experiencing their non-existence customer service first hand." 

I had a phone call within 3 hours, where I had been waiting 4 days for an answer to a simple question.

I ended up visiting LASIK MD in City Centre on December 3rd, 2019. I personally dealt with Lindsey, Jesse, Victoria & Phyllis, all of which were friendly, helped explained the process and were educated to answer the questions I had. 

I do feel the communication is a bit slow and believe the only reason I received a call back was because of the 1-Star negative review but I will be following through with the surgery in 2020 and will update my review at that time when I've used their services.

Great results but a huge hassle!
Constant follow ups even though they originally tell you 2-3times. Every time I call to to find out when I get a different story. 
I asked for a letter indicating the dates I attended for tax purposes and they want me to pay them $20. I paid over 3grand for my surgery and they have the nerve to charge for a simple letter.  If there was a zero rating I'd put 0. This place is a joke.

I was -4.75 in my left eye, -6.75 in my right.

My surgeon is/was incredible! I worked with Dr. Mahta Rasouli, and she is absolutely fabulous! She is so accomplished, very experienced, and so kindhearted. I wasn't nervous, as they gave me Xanax, so I was pretty relaxed and actually even excited. The only thing that made me nervous was the suction ring. This came onto my eye after the speculum. It's part of the process to create the flap. Dr. Rasouli talked me through it, and I did some deep breathing to relax. There were 4 women in the room, one holding my hand, and two assisting her. The whole thing took 5 mins for both eyes!! The speculum holding my eyes open didn't bother me. Laser didn't bother me. But that suction ring really bothered me.

4 hours after the surgery ended, I could see 80% clear. The eye drops stung like hell, but they promised they would only bother me for the first two hours, and it did go away fairly quickly. I got a migraine along with the eye pain, so the drive home was horrible. I sat in the backseat trying to deep breathe. (Most people don't have migraines, my body is just overly sensitive.)

The next morning I was perfectly fine! It's so surreal when you wake up and can see mostly everything. I had very little cloudiness and could easily clean the area around my eyes with no pain. My follow-up went spectacularly. I'm seeing better than 20/20 already. Dr. Rasouli has to take a bit more tissue from my right eye because the prescription was high, so it's a little blurrier than the left. No infection, no inflammation, and I'm healing quickly! I am very, very happy.  My next appointment is in 2 weeks. 

Thank you for everything, Lasik!

Lasik! I took the plunge and had the surgery over the weekend, and I have quite a bit to say about it!

I did a lot of "interviewing" before booking my consultation with friends who have been though the experience. I wanted to know if the discomfort would be worth the lasting benefits. Everyone I talked to raved about the experience saying it was "nothing" and that I would wish I'd done it sooner.

The consultation went well- they seemed professional and competent. One concern I had was that everyone seemed to have to repeat the same information so often that many staff talked in a "script-like" way, rattling off instructions or information very quickly. I really appreciate being well informed for something as serious as a surgery, so I had to ask a lot of questions and tell a lot of people to slow down.

The day of surgery went pretty well. The procedure, however, was a lot more difficult than I had anticipated, and I was very scared and uncomfortable. None of my interviewing had prepared me for it. However, the doctor and the individuals assisting him were so kind and supportive, and they got me through it.

The recovery day was pretty easy to start with, then the pain ramped up dorm a few hours, and a  week later my eyes are doing great and I can see so well! The clinic had also been great in follow up appointments, and have answered all my questions. They have also been great on the phone!
